en_title: Judge Denies Motion to Dismiss RAM Price Fixing Lawsuit
cn_title: 法官驳回撤销内存价格操纵诉讼的动议
opus_summary: 针对Micron、SK Hynix和Samsung涉嫌合谋操纵内存价格并缩减产量的集体诉讼，法官驳回了三家公司提出的撤诉动议，案件将继续审理。法官的命令称，原告指控传统DRAM价格在18个月内上涨697%；诉讼可能还需数年才会作出最终裁决。

paragraphs.en: Even if you've been under a rock all year, it's hard to ignore the massive RAM crisis that's been going on since late 2025. And while prices likely won't improve, it does seem like there's a small possibility that the three major RAM manufacturers might face some accountability.
paragraphs.cn: 即使你一整年都与世隔绝，也很难忽视自2025年底以来持续的大规模内存危机。虽然价格可能不会改善，但三大内存制造商似乎还是有一线可能被追究一些责任。

paragraphs.en: A class action lawsuit accusing Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung of colluding to fix the price of RAM while simultaneously scaling back production was filed back in June. This kind of case will likely take years to go through the system. But the RAM companies filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit, arguing that each company made "rational choices consistent with their own independent self interest" and that the case was just a "rerun" of a similar case from 2022. But on Friday, Judge Noël Wise denied the motion .
paragraphs.cn: 早在6月，一项集体诉讼便已提起，指控美光、SK海力士和三星串通操纵内存价格，同时缩减产量。这类案件走完司法程序可能需要数年时间。但这些内存公司提出动议，要求撤销诉讼，辩称各家公司都作出了「符合各自独立自身利益的理性选择」，而这起案件只是2022年一起类似案件的「重演」。但在周五，法官Noël Wise驳回了该动议。

paragraphs.en: Wise's order references the previous case, which was dismissed, saying, "During the hearing, Defendants quoted the late Honorable Judge Posner who famously wrote, '[c]ompetitors in concentrated markets watch each other like hawks.'" But then added, "But Plaintiffs’ allegations go beyond hawks watching each other; their contentions are more akin to hawks flying in formation – an activity that hawks ordinarily do not do."
paragraphs.cn: Wise的命令提到了此前被驳回的案件，称：「在听证会上，被告引用了已故尊敬的Posner法官的一句名言：『集中市场中的竞争者像鹰一样盯着彼此。』」但随后又补充道：「但原告的指控不止是鹰盯着彼此；他们所主张的情形更像是鹰在编队飞行——这是鹰通常不会做的事。」

paragraphs.en: Now, before you go and celebrate that RAM prices are going to come crashing down, this order simply means that the case will move forward – the fight isn't over yet. This class action lawsuit will probably be moving through the courts for a couple years before any final decision is made.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，在你为内存价格即将暴跌而庆祝之前，请注意这项命令仅仅意味着案件将继续推进——这场较量还没有结束。这起集体诉讼可能还要在法院审理几年，才会作出最终裁决。

paragraphs.en: While the previous 2022 class action was dismissed, the three companies named in this lawsuit do have a history of working together to manipulate the RAM market. All the way back in 2002, the U.S. Department of Justice investigated a "criminal cartel" made up of Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron in order to fix prices. That investigation ended in jail time for a Samsung executive, along with a $300 million fine for Samsung and a $185 million fine for SK Hynix.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然此前2022年的集体诉讼被驳回，但这起诉讼中被点名的三家公司确有合作操纵内存市场的历史。早在2002年，美国司法部就调查过一个由三星、SK海力士和美光组成、旨在操纵价格的「犯罪卡特尔」。那次调查最终导致一名三星高管入狱，三星被罚款3亿美元，SK海力士被罚款1.85亿美元。

paragraphs.en: If anything, though, the RAM market is worse for consumers than either of the two times that the three RAM companies have been accused of price fixing. According to the order, the last class action came after memory prices spiked by 165% in 2018. But compared to 2026, that's nothing. The order says, "In sum, Plaintiffs allege a 697% price increase for conventional DRAM over an eighteen-month period." Looking at RAM kits on Amazon, it's hard to deny that number.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，如果说有什么区别的话，现在的内存市场对消费者来说比这三家内存公司此前两次被指控操纵价格时更糟。根据该命令，上一次集体诉讼是在2018年内存价格飙升165%之后提起的。但与2026年相比，这根本不算什么。命令称：「总而言之，原告指称传统DRAM的价格在18个月内上涨了697%。」看看亚马逊上的内存套装，就很难否认这个数字。

paragraphs.en: Only time will tell how this lawsuit will play out, but no matter what happens, it doesn't seem like RAM prices are going to improve any time soon. Samsung told investors during its latest earnings call that "AI-driven demand [is] likely to further tighten supply shortages" next year. That was after all three memory manufacturers reported selling through their 2027 manufacturing capacity all the way back in August 2026 . It's no wonder that Xbox Project Helix is rumored to hit $1,800 .
paragraphs.cn: 这起诉讼将如何发展只有时间才能给出答案，但无论发生什么，内存价格似乎都不会在短期内改善。三星在最近一次财报电话会议上告诉投资者，明年「人工智能驱动的需求可能会进一步加剧供应短缺」。在此之前，三家内存制造商早在2026年8月就已报告称，其2027年的产能已全部售罄。难怪有传言称XBOX Project Helix的价格将达到1800美元。
